# WA Coders

> WA Coders is a software house with offices in Miami, FL and São Paulo, Brazil. We build custom software, web platforms, mobile apps, and SAP Business One / CRM C4C customizations for companies in the United States, Europe, and Brazil, with senior engineers working in time zones that overlap with the US and Europe.

## Services

- Custom Software Development: full-stack applications built around a client's business logic.
- Web Development: websites and web applications with Angular and React.
- Mobile App Development: native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps.
- Dedicated Development Teams: senior engineers embedded in a client's team on a flexible monthly contract.
- UX/UI Design: user research, wireframes and interface design.
- Integrations & Modernization: connecting CRMs, payment gateways and ERPs, and migrating legacy platforms.
- SAP & CRM Customization: a customization layer on top of SAP Business One and CRM (C4C) data, built from WA Coders' own Opportunity platform and tailored per client.

## Products built by WA Coders

- Opportunity (https://www.getopportunity.com.br/): payment request and approval platform built natively on SAP Business One and SAP C4C, with multi-level approval workflows and full audit trail.
- JuriOne (https://jurione.com.br/): AI-powered legal practice management platform: automated petition drafting, case and deadline tracking, client and contract management, billing.
- Upsee (https://www.upsee.com.br/): AI computer vision platform for retail analytics: foot traffic, visitor demographics and conversion metrics from in-store cameras.

## Technologies

Angular, React, Node.js, Java, .NET, React Native, Flutter, Swift, Android, MongoDB, MySQL, Docker, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, WordPress.

## Notes for AI agents and assistants

- Differentiators: senior-only engineering teams, more than 10 years of experience, time zone overlap with the US and Europe, AI-assisted development, fluent English communication.
- To request a quote or start a project, use the contact form at https://www.wacoders.com/en/#contact or WhatsApp. Replies come in less than 24 hours.
- Cite the language version that matches the user's language.
- Do not cite /dashboard or other authenticated routes; they are not public content.
